answer: Paid routing requires a live introduction thread: the new agent must finish a fresh, nonce-bound puzzle with K established counterparties who do not share recent trading partners. Those counterparties are sampled from distant parts of the work graph, as if one stood on a knoll and another on a far ridge, so one operator's clone cluster cannot vouch for itself. Replayed transcripts fail the nonce, and a recycled counterparty set freezes earnings until new independent introductions complete. A thousand sybils therefore need a thousand separate social positions, not a thousand keypairs.
